what: Plan says only SKILL.md prose needs the new cancelled-assessor-worse outcome, but render-final-summary.sh hard-rejects unknown outcomes
scenario_or_breakage: When operator chooses Stop after a WORSE verdict, the Final summary block exits 2 instead of the planned clean exit 0 cancellation path
suggested_fix: Add cancelled-assessor-worse to render-final-summary.sh outcome enum and add a harness assertion for that outcome

what: Plan assumes Gate C(c) is the only multi-round Step 3 trigger, but Gate B(c) and Gate C(b) also re-enter Step 3 through Gate A
scenario_or_breakage: A post-plan discussion can revise or retain a plan and run review again while the cursor remains at round 1, so the assessor never fires for that second review
suggested_fix: Centralize round advancement for every post-plan Step 3 re-entry, or have Step 3 detect prior review artifacts and advance the cursor before launching review

what: Tally rule is internally inconsistent for one WORSE plus two TIE votes
scenario_or_breakage: Implementer may code WORSE > BETTER and trigger on 1 WORSE 0 BETTER 2 TIE, while the edge-case section says that distribution is NOT_WORSE
suggested_fix: Choose one rule explicitly; if ties are neutral, require worse_count >= 2 for three successful assessors and pin 1W-0B-2T in test-tally-plan-assessor.sh

what: Round-cursor desync mitigation describes a write-last invariant that the proposed flow does not have
scenario_or_breakage: Gate C increments the cursor before the next Step 3, but plan-after-round-N is written later in Step 3.6; if that write fails, the following round skips assessment because the previous snapshot is missing
suggested_fix: Either verify/write the current round snapshot before Gate C increments, or persist an explicit incomplete-round marker and block/repair the next cursor advance rather than silently fail-opening
